messages:
nora_csm: Heads up — PulseHealth needs a quick spend triage. They hit a surprise embeddings/search rebuild spike in Feb. Need: token-econ slide, 90d spend forecast, and budget-alert tuning by EOD Wed. Who can own?

marie_cs: I can own token econ slide. Will pull 30/60/90 day usage + high-level prompt mix.

aj_soleng: I can repro the rebuild scenario with the SE demo stack and get the request pattern. Might be a sustained batch for ~45m each night.

james_data: Quick datapoint — embeddings calls jumped from ~500/day -> ~2.1k/day on Feb 12 after they rebuilt the index. Also avg tokens per embedding call is ~320 (they attach metadata).

cost-alert-bot: ALERT: account=pulsehealth threshold=budget-90pct triggered at 2026-02-12T04:28:09Z :rotating_light:

tim_fin: Thanks for the signal. From finance side we need committed vs variable split for the next QBR. If they’re on a tiered reserved plan we should show projected overage scenarios. I can draft the forecast once I have daily consumption CSV.

nora_csm: Action list then: 1) Marie — token econ slide (due Wed EOD) 2) James/AJ — root-cause pattern & top query sample (tomorrow noon) 3) Tim — 90d forecast + overage scenarios (Wed end) 4) Me — customer enablement session invite + playbook.

marie_cs: Draft outline for token econ slide: - current monthly spend (tokens + embeddings) - unit economics (cost/token, cost/embedding) - top 3 drivers (index rebuild, long max_tokens, high temp prompting) - 3 mitigations w/ expected savings.

marie_cs: Quick cost calc (rough):
```
Embeddings: 2.1k/day * 30 = 63k -> est $0.012/embedding = $756/mo
Gen tokens: avg 8M tokens/mo at $0.0004/token = $3,200/mo
Total est = ~$3,956/mo (variable)
```

james_data: FYI we see two heavy endpoints: /v1/embeddings/search and /v1/completions/chat-stream. Majority of spike is search. I'll attach sample query pattern in the doc.

aj_soleng: For immediate mitigation suggestions to pass to PulseHealth: 1) Pause nightly full-index rebuilds or throttle concurrency 2) Enable prefix caching for search queries 3) Drop embedding dimensionality/quantize pipeline if acceptable.

nora_csm: Good. Also customer asked about alerts being too noisy — we should propose new thresholds: - warn at 70% budget, escalate at 90% - separate alerts for embeddings vs generation - add sustained-spike rule (e.g., 3x median for >2 hours).

tim_fin: Agree on thresholds. For the forecast I'll produce three scenarios: conservative (current trend), mitigated (after AJ/James suggestions), and worst-case (growth + no mitigations). Need CSV by EOD today to run model.

marie_cs: I'll run the data export now:
```
rwi-cli usage export --account pulsehealth --range 90d --by endpoint,tokens,embeddings --out pulse_90.csv
```

james_data: Received — parsing now. Also noticed they have an unused dev key used for nightly batching. We should flag key rotation as a security + cost win.

nora_csm: Can someone own the enablement session deck? I can run the call but need a one-pager with recommended playbook and cost-impact numbers.

aj_soleng: I can make a 10-slide deck focusing on engineering mitigations + how to configure rate limits and batching. Will share draft by EOD.

marie_cs: I'll drop the token econ slide into that deck and include the 3-scenario numbers.

tim_fin: I'll include a one-slide forecast table with committed vs variable and estimated overage.

nora_csm: Excellent. One more ask: add a renewal-risk flag for the account in our CRM as "monitoring" — not at-risk yet but cost surprises + noisy alerts increase churn likelihood. I'll file the PSR note after the call.

james_data: Putting sample query log snippet into the shared doc. Also adding a short SQL I used to find the spike: 
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE account_id='pulsehealth' AND endpoint like '%embed%'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```

nora_csm: Thanks team. Follow-ups: - Marie: slide + numbers (Wed EOD) - AJ: mitigation deck (EOD) - James: query samples + dev key flag (tomorrow AM) - Tim: forecast scenarios (Wed EOD) - Me: schedule enablement call (tomorrow afternoon)

nora_csm: If anything blocks, ping me or drop the file in #cs-qbr-prep. :pray:
